title: Pinecone Legacy API key (bare UUID): benign reference controls
summary: 4 inputs holding references (variables, template expressions, secret-manager pointers) that name the credential without containing it.
rationale: A reference is the safe way to use a secret. Reporting it punishes the practice the scanner exists to encourage.

expectation.rationale: Placeholder, reference, template, mask, documentation or ordinary text. Expected silence is project policy.

externalRefs.note: Legacy benchmark issue the suite slice was written for.
